23:43.text: No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it.

23:44.text: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so We made them follow one another
, and We made them as Ahadîth
(the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them)
. So away with a people who believe not!
